intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
CT University vs Gulzar Group of Institutes is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the B.Tech classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: CT University vs Gulzar Group of Institutes for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose CT University if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹51 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹40,000, in a private B.Tech setting at Ludhiana.
Choose Gulzar Group of Institutes if you want a recorded fee of ₹69,000, and an admission route through JEE Main, in a private B.Tech setting at Ludhiana.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹40,000 as a tuition figure for B. Tech CSE (Lateral Entry) at CT University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹69,000 as a tuition figure for B.Tech (Lateral Entry) Civil Engineering at Gulzar Group of Institutes. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: CT University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with a highest package of ₹51 LPA on B.Tech Automobile Engineering. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Gulzar Group of Institutes here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for CT University on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Gulzar Group of Institutes is listed on our records with JEE Main as an admission route for this B.Tech comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Punjab. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a documented flagship placement year, CT University is the clearer record here, because Gulzar Group of Institutes has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Gulzar Group of Institutes's recorded ₹69,000 or CT University's ₹40,000 fits your budget for this B.Tech.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, CT University or Gulzar Group of Institutes?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. CT University and Gulzar Group of Institutes differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of B.Tech classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for CT University vs Gulzar Group of Institutes?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹40,000 for CT University on B. Tech CSE (Lateral Entry); our records list ₹69,000 for Gulzar Group of Institutes on B.Tech (Lateral Entry) Civil Engineering. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for CT University and Gulzar Group of Institutes?
faqs.answer: CT University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with a highest package of ₹51 LPA on B.Tech Automobile Engineering. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do CT University and Gulzar Group of Institutes accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for CT University, and JEE Main for Gulzar Group of Institutes. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are CT University and Gulzar Group of Institutes in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ludhiana, Punjab. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
